name: Portal
author: g3ortega
description: Listening TCP ports with framework detection, live metrics, process controls, local names via Portless, and public sharing via Cloudflare or ngrok.

barWidget.description: Listening ports, what is running on them, and public sharing.

schema.label: Portless TLD
schema.description: Suffix for local names. The default localhost needs no resolver changes. Other suffixes need a resolver rule and proxy restart; Settings shows the required commands.

schema.label: Portless name
schema.description: Name local routes after the detected project, or as port-<number>.

schema.label: Show system ports
schema.description: Include DNS, printing, SSH, and Portal's own proxy and tunnel processes.

schema.label: Framework icon colors
schema.description: Brand uses each framework's own color. Theme uses your Omarchy palette.

schema.label: Refresh interval
schema.description: Seconds between port scans. Scans collect socket and process metrics and probe selected HTTP services.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Show public shares, otherwise named routes, otherwise dev servers next to the Portal icon. Hide the count when zero.
